hub.prompt: Edit target: supplied existing Minecraft menu item artwork. Preserve its personality, subject, arrangement and main colors, but moderately simplify for small inventory display. Keep the round gold compass, navy/cyan face, four gold cardinal points, cyan central gem and top loop. Remove perimeter gems and tiny dial ticks; reduce inner star to four main points. Medium-detail colorful pixel art, NOT a monochrome symbol or minimalist glyph. Design on a clean 32x32 logical pixel grid enlarged with nearest-neighbor; broad pixel clusters, 10-14 flat colors, one navy outline pixel, two tones per material. No gradients, antialiasing, texture noise, tiny glints or extra objects. Centered full icon with 2 logical pixels transparent padding, genuinely transparent background, square canvas. Main silhouette fills about 85% of canvas. This will be viewed at 16x16 and 32x32; prioritize recognizable large features.
